metadata.title: FAQ · Moodwave
metadata.description: Answers about Moodwave: real songs, guest mode, Spotify sign-in, saving, sharing and your data.

attributes.text: Help
Questions, answered.
The short version of how Moodwave works, what it can do, and what it can’t (yet).
What is Moodwave?
Describe a moment, a feeling or a place in your own words. Moodwave’s AI reads the mood, plans the arc of a playlist and picks songs to match, then you can play it, tweak it and save it to Spotify.
Are the songs real?
Yes. Every pick is searched for on Spotify and only kept if it matches a real track, so nothing is invented. Songs that can’t be verified are swapped for ones that can.

children.name: Do I need a Spotify account?

attributes.text: Do I need a Spotify account?

No. Choose “Try it as a guest” to make playlists with the real catalogue and the full AI. Guests can make up to 5 playlists a day, up to 30 songs each, and can’t save to Spotify. If you later sign in with Spotify, your guest playlists come with you. Guest sessions and their playlists are kept for 30 days.

children.name: Why can’t I sign in with Spotify?

attributes.text: Why can’t I sign in with Spotify?

Spotify keeps new apps in development mode, which only lets a short list of invited accounts sign in. If yours isn’t on it you’ll see an invite-only message, and you can still use Moodwave as a guest.

children.name: How long can a playlist be?

attributes.text: How long can a playlist be?

Anywhere from 15 to 100 songs when signed in with Spotify, and up to 30 as a guest. Asking for one artist (“Don Toliver night songs”) keeps it to that artist and their features, and tops up with clearly tagged similar artists if they run out of fitting songs.

children.name: Why do some songs only play for 30 seconds?

attributes.text: Why do some songs only play for 30 seconds?
Playback uses Spotify’s own player. If you’re logged in to Spotify in the same browser you hear full tracks, otherwise Spotify plays a 30-second preview.

children.name: Can I change a playlist after it’s made?

attributes.text: Can I change a playlist after it’s made?

Yes. Reorder, swap or remove songs, rename it, change the cover, or ask for changes in plain words (“make it more upbeat”). If it’s already on Spotify, use “Update on Spotify” to copy your edits across.

children.name: Does it learn what I like?

attributes.text: Does it learn what I like?

Thumbs up and down on songs steer future playlists: liked songs nudge the feel, disliked songs are avoided, and an artist you dislike twice is left out. Signed-in listeners can also turn on “Blend my taste” to lightly mix in their top Spotify artists.
How do sharing links work?
“Share” makes a link anyone can open to see and play the playlist, without signing in. They can’t edit it. Turning the link off stops it working everywhere.

children.name: How do I delete my data?

attributes.text: How do I delete my data?
Open the account menu and choose “Delete my account and data”. It removes your playlists, covers, share links and thumbs straight away. Playlists you saved to Spotify stay in Spotify.
Is Moodwave free?
Yes. It’s a personal project, with no ads and nothing to buy.
Something else? Open an issue on GitHub →
